title: Brush Engagement No Suggestions
description: Brush tool shows no preview or engagement suggestions when hovering near unconnected nodes (e.g. tambour). Fix brush slot hit-testing and anchor positions to match indirect-handle UX.
summary: Fixed brush slot discovery so hovering near unconnected nodes (node body, indirect ring, or flush slot) activates preview and engagement candidates. Brush anchors now use indirect-handle positions at overview/normal LOD with zoom-aware hit tolerance matching link hover.
